description: Use when an agent needs an exact unit conversion. Returns the value converted between units of length, mass, volume, time, data, speed, area, pressure, energy or temperature, to 12 significant digits. Mixing categories is a 400, never billed. Costs 0.005 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

from.description: unit, e.g. mi, kg, GiB, C

to.description: unit, e.g. km, lb, MB, F

name: get_convert
